title: Figure 21 pointed modular comparison with independently calibrated presentation normalization
top_notice: The pointed modular Figure 21 batch is complete for the recorded rank 2-5 pointed rows. The historical raw graph comparison still records a +1/-1 bucket swap in both rank-2 semion rows. A separate fail-closed audit now derives the correction -1 solely from the ordinary Kirby-color aggregate (-32 on Figure 21 versus +32 on the split standard presentation), then independently verifies the full distribution. All 15 pointed rows match after this presentation normalization; the other 13 use correction +1. This remains distribution-level evidence, not an H2-certified exoticness theorem or a global no-signal theorem.

same_label_standard_comparison.rank2_raw_difference_summary: Both semion rows have the same raw same-label difference from the split standard distribution, {'+1+0i': -32, '-1+0i': 32}, after removing Figure 21 zero projector sectors.
same_label_standard_comparison.rank2_presentation_normalization_summary: Both semion rows have ordinary raw aggregates -32 on Figure 21 and +32 on the split standard side. The independently derived presentation correction is therefore -1+0i. Applying that correction makes the complete distribution match; bucket alignment was not used to select it.
same_label_standard_comparison.rank3_summary: Both Z3 rows match the split standard distribution after removing Figure 21 zero projector sectors; their phase alignment multiplier is +1+0i.
same_label_standard_comparison.rank4_summary: All 9 rank-4 pointed rows match the split standard distribution after removing Figure 21 zero projector sectors.
same_label_standard_comparison.rank5_summary: Both rank-5 SU(5)_1 pointed rows match the split standard distribution after removing Figure 21 zero projector sectors.
same_label_standard_comparison.comparison_rule: For each validated pointed dimension-one category, derive nu_C=(sum standard fixed-label amplitudes)/(sum Figure 21 fixed-label amplitudes) before comparing buckets; require nu_C to be a unit scalar; then require the complete normalized distribution to equal the split CP2#9(-CP2) distribution. No certified H2 coordinate identification is used.
